plugins.name: py-pit
plugins.description: Opinionated Python API development skills for AI coding agents.

skills.name: alembic-migrations
skills.description: Production-safe Alembic migration workflows for SQLAlchemy 2.x projects. Use this skill when adding Alembic, generating migrations, reviewing autogenerate diffs, fixing broken migrations, or establishing a safe schema evolution workflow in a Python backend.
skills.description_zh: 为SQLAlchemy 2.x项目建立Alembic迁移流程，覆盖接入、生成、自动差异审查、损坏迁移修复和安全模式演进。

skills.name: background-jobs-boundaries
skills.description: Guardrails for background work in FastAPI and Python services. Prevent misuse of in-process background execution (e.g. FastAPI BackgroundTasks).
headings: Do not use background tasks when the work is:
skills.description_zh: 为FastAPI和Python服务的后台执行设定边界，防止误用进程内后台任务，例如FastAPI BackgroundTasks。

skills.name: click-cli-linter
skills.description: Audit and improve existing Python Click CLIs by identifying architecture problems, anti-patterns, and CLI UX issues, then proposing minimal, high-value fixes.
skills.description_zh: 审查已有Python Click命令行工具，识别架构、反模式和用户体验问题，提出少量高价值修复。

skills.name: click-cli
skills.description: Design, generate, and improve Python CLIs using the Click library. Focus on idiomatic architecture, command groups, modular layouts, CLI UX conventions, and avoiding common Click anti-patterns.
headings: 1. Model the CLI before writing code
4. Prefer modular command layouts for multi-command CLIs
skills.description_zh: 使用Python Click设计、生成及改进命令行工具，关注惯用架构、命令分组、模块布局和CLI体验，避免常见反模式。

skills.name: code-quality
skills.description: Opinionated code health stack for Python repos using Ruff, pre-commit, and Markdown linting. Prefers consolidation over redundant tooling, preserves working repos unless migration is requested, and provides a simple adoption path for both new and existing projects.
skills.description_zh: 为Python仓库配置Ruff、pre-commit和Markdown检查的代码健康工具栈，优先整合而非重复工具，除非要求迁移否则保留现有可工作结构，并提供渐进采用路径。

skills.name: dockerize-service
skills.description: Generate a local-development Docker Compose setup for an existing Python project. Produces a multi-stage Dockerfile, Compose file, env config, and dockerignore based on detected project signals.
headings: Local development only — not a production deployment target
docker compose environment — do not commit real secrets
docker compose environment — do not commit real secrets
skills.description_zh: 为已有Python项目生成本地开发Docker Compose环境，根据项目特征产出多阶段Dockerfile、Compose、环境配置和dockerignore。

skills.name: fastapi-errors
skills.description: Opinionated error architecture for FastAPI services. Enforces a single internal exception hierarchy, constructor-based messages, consistent API error responses, and centralized logging for unexpected failures.
skills.description_zh: 建立FastAPI统一错误架构，使用单一内部异常层级、构造器消息、一致API错误响应及意外失败集中日志。

skills.name: fastapi-init
skills.description: Scaffold a complete, production-ready FastAPI project from scratch. Use this skill whenever the user wants to create, initialize, start, or bootstrap a FastAPI service, REST API, or Python web service — even if they just say "new service", "new API", or "new microservice". Handles uv setup, standard FastAPI directory layout, uvicorn runner, click CLI entry point, and a full pytest suite with DI overrides, AsyncClient, and async SQLite fixtures. Always invoke for new Python API projects.
headings: see fastapi-errors skill for extended patterns (context logging, error codes, auth errors)
skills.description_zh: 从零搭建FastAPI服务，包括uv、标准目录、uvicorn、Click入口和pytest测试，配置依赖注入覆盖、AsyncClient及异步SQLite夹具；适用于新Python API或微服务项目。

skills.name: http-client-integration
skills.description: Production-ready async HTTP client integration for Python backend services. Use this skill when adding or refactoring outbound API calls, building a vendor client, introducing retries and timeouts, validating external payloads, or replacing ad-hoc HTTP usage with a disciplined integration boundary.
skills.description_zh: 为Python后端接入异步HTTP客户端，规范外部API边界、重试、超时和返回数据验证，适用于供应商客户端及零散HTTP调用重构。

skills.name: implementation-protocol
skills.description: Orchestrate feature implementation with a behavior-first, minimal-patch discipline. Use this skill whenever the user asks you to implement a feature, add functionality, build an endpoint, wire up a new capability, or make any non-trivial code change in a Python/FastAPI project. Also use when the user says "build this", "add support for X", "implement X", or describes a feature they want working. This skill is about the *process* of turning intent into a verified, reviewable change - not about any single framework or tool.
skills.description_zh: 以行为目标优先、最小修改的方法推进Python/FastAPI功能实施，将端点或新能力需求转成可验证、可审查的变更；提供实施流程而非特定框架工具。

skills.name: pydantic-schemas
skills.description: Opinionated schema architecture for Python API projects using Pydantic v2. Defines request, response, query, command, batch, and pagination schema patterns to prevent schema drift in new projects.
skills.description_zh: 使用Pydantic v2规范Python API的请求、响应、查询、命令、批次及分页模式，避免新项目的数据结构漂移。

skills.name: pytest-service
skills.description: Write disciplined backend tests for FastAPI services with pytest. Use this skill when adding tests to a Python/FastAPI service, setting up async SQLAlchemy test fixtures, wiring AsyncClient with DI overrides, mocking external clients, or improving test maintainability. Covers fixture design, factory patterns, async SQLite in-memory databases, app.dependency_overrides, and avoiding fragile or redundant tests.
skills.description_zh: 为FastAPI编写pytest后端测试，覆盖夹具、工厂、异步SQLAlchemy、内存SQLite、AsyncClient、依赖覆盖及外部客户端模拟，减少脆弱和重复测试。

skills.name: request-correlation
skills.description: Enforce end-to-end request correlation across HTTP handlers, services, outbound HTTP calls, background jobs, and async tasks using contextvars. Use this skill whenever request tracing, correlation IDs, observability wiring, or propagating context across task/job boundaries is involved — even outside FastAPI (Celery workers, CLI tasks, plain asyncio apps). Ensures correlation IDs propagate across boundaries and exceptions are logged exactly once.
skills.description_zh: 通过contextvars贯通HTTP处理器、服务、外部请求、后台作业和异步任务的关联ID，并保证异常只记录一次；也适用于Celery、CLI和普通asyncio。

skills.name: settings-config
skills.description: Production-ready configuration management for Python backend projects using pydantic-settings. Use this skill when the user needs to add environment variable management, introduce pydantic-settings, replace scattered os.getenv usage, add a settings module, or set up .env support in a FastAPI service or Python backend.
headings: Step 0 — Inspect the existing project first
skills.description_zh: 用pydantic-settings统一Python后端配置和环境变量，替换散落的os.getenv，添加设置模块及.env支持。

skills.name: sqlalchemy-models
skills.description: Production-ready SQLAlchemy 2.x model patterns for Python backend projects. Use this skill when the user needs to define ORM models, add relationships, introduce a canonical DeclarativeBase, create shared mixins, organize a models package, or fix inconsistent SQLAlchemy model structure in a FastAPI or Python backend.
headings: Step 0 — Inspect the existing project first
When not to use this skill
5) Forward references to reduce import pressure
skills.description_zh: 提供SQLAlchemy 2.x ORM模式，定义模型关系、统一DeclarativeBase、共享mixin及models目录，修正FastAPI或Python后端模型结构不一致。

skills.name: uv
skills.description: Expert guidance for correct uv usage in Python projects. Handles dependency management, environments, command execution, migration from pip/poetry/pip-tools, lockfile correctness, and uv anti-patterns.
headings: 4. Tools use uv tool or uvx
skills.description_zh: 指导Python项目正确使用uv，覆盖依赖、环境、命令执行、从pip/poetry/pip-tools迁移、锁文件正确性及反模式。
